title: Food macro at 1080p
style: Food photography, 100mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, warm tungsten key light, dark wooden table.

keyframes.prompt: A steaming bowl of tonkotsu ramen seen from a low angle: chashu slices, a halved soft egg with an amber yolk, scallions, nori, chopsticks resting on the rim. 16:9 composition.

shots.video_prompt: Slow push-in toward the egg as chopsticks lift a strand of noodles that drips broth back into the bowl. Steam curls through the light. Gentle bubbling and a soft slurp.
